newsletter.justification: The newsletter follows all formatting rules including character limits and bold subheadings while accurately capturing the core ideas of the talk.

flyer.justification: The flyer meets the title length constraint of 6 words and uses high-impact lines with TBA placeholders appropriately.

linkedin.justification: The post has an engaging hook, avoids forbidden buzzwords, and includes relevant hashtags alongside a thought-provoking vacation question.

instagram.justification: The caption effectively integrates carousel visual cues, emojis, a call to action, and the required number of targeted hashtags.

summary.justification: The executive summary perfectly organizes the required sections (TL;DR, evidence, discussion points, action items) under 400 words.

blog.justification: The blog post adheres to all structural constraints, featuring numbered sections, a comparison table, and an About the Author section.
